description: Every update PR runs the full CI matrix (including the --config=werror gate), so a bump that breaks a platform or trips a new warning shows up as a red leg, not a surprise on main.

packageRules.description: maven.install artifact bumps invalidate maven_install.json, which Renovate cannot repin; the golden-freshness CI leg stays red until it is regenerated.
prBodyNotes: **Repin required**: run `bazel run @smithy_cpp_codegen_maven//:pin` and commit the updated `maven_install.json` before merging.

packageRules.description: The Boost BCR modules move in lockstep; one PR per Boost release instead of one per module.
The software.amazon.smithy artifacts ship in lockstep; one PR per Smithy release instead of five.
The com.disneystreaming.alloy artifacts ship in lockstep; one PR per alloy release.
smithy_cpp is consumed via local/git override (version 0.0.0 until BCR publication); there is nothing to look up, and the attempt produces a dashboard warning.

customManagers.description: docs/quickstart.md embeds the consumer example's MODULE.bazel snippet, and QuickstartMirrorTest fails the codegen CI leg whenever the two drift — so the doc's bazel_dep lines version-bump together with the real files.
